document.description: The document's title, as a person would cite it.

url.description: Where it was read from on the web.

file.description: The file it was read from.

heading.description: The section's heading in the document.

text.description: The section's text, as the document has it. Approvals hash it (whitespace collapsed), so a changed word makes its passages stale.

sections.description: The document's sections, by id (a number like "3.2" or a short name).

description: kb/sources/<doc>.yaml: one source document's text by section.
